messages.content: What year is !Ω Factorial Omega set in?
It's 2027. The city is a sprawling, decaying megacity where poverty and inequality grind into everyday life.
Describe the setting and environment in MDRG.

The protagonist lives in a poor ghetto district of a megacity characterized by poverty, inflation, surveillance, heavy police enforcement, underground black markets, and stark inequality between the rich and impoverished.
What kind of city does Anon live in?
Anon lives in a sprawling, decaying megacity. His home is a poor ghetto district — surveillance, black markets, poverty everywhere.
Is the game's world prosperous or declining?
The world depicted in this world is dystopian and declining, characterized by a decaying megacity, widespread poverty, inflation, and heavy police enforcement in poor districts.
How does inflation factor into MDRG's survival gameplay?
Inflation erodes currency value over time in this world, increasing survival pressure and forcing you to constantly earn money for rent, food, clothes, and bot parts.
Were sexbots ever legal in the MDRG world?
Yes. Before the international scandal and ban, sexbots were legal and boomed in popularity, serving as mainstream consumer products for companionship and intimate interaction.
What was the sexbot industry like before the ban?
Sexbots were legal, mainstream consumer products that enjoyed widespread popularity. They were explicitly manufactured for sex and intimate interaction, and their industry thrived before the scandal.
Why were sexbots so popular before they were banned?
Sexbots were wildly popular because they were advanced humanoid companions explicitly designed for sex and intimate interaction, serving as both relationship simulators and intimate partners.
Were sexbots considered illegal before the international scandal?
No. Sexbots were legal and booming in popularity before the USA–China scandal. The scandal triggered the worldwide ban that made them illegal.
What does it mean that Jun was manufactured for 'Sex and Intimate Interaction'?
Jun, like all sexbots, was originally designed and manufactured specifically to serve as a companion for sexual and intimate interaction—her core design purpose in the pre-ban era.
What caused the worldwide sexbot ban?
An international scandal between the USA and China triggered the worldwide ban on sexbots. This event—sometimes described as a war or conflict—led to countrywide bans and massive upheaval.
How did the USA and China scandal affect sexbots?
After an international scandal (sometimes described as a war) between the USA and China, a worldwide ban on sexbots was enacted, outlawing the previously legal industry overnight.
Did the sexbot ban cause riots?
Yes. The worldwide ban on sexbots triggered countrywide riots as the population reacted to the sudden criminalization of a once-legal, popular product.
What happened to sexbot production after the international scandal?
Production facilities collapsed following the worldwide ban. Sexbots became scarce and highly illegal, with their existence now known mostly through the dark web and black markets.
Are sexbots manufactured anymore in MDRG's world?
No. Production facilities have collapsed. Sexbots are no longer manufactured and have become scarce contraband, with knowledge of them existing primarily in dark-web circles and black markets.
Did militias form because of the sexbot shortage?
Yes. After the ban, militias rose and fought for control of the remaining sexbot units, as the suddenly illegal robots became valuable assets in a lawless black market.
What role did militias play in the post-ban chaos?
Militias emerged and fought for control of the remaining sexbot units following the worldwide ban, representing one of many groups competing for scarce, highly illegal robots.
How is owning a sexbot viewed in MDRG's society?
Owning or hiding a sexbot is illegal and extremely dangerous. Discovery risks police raids, making possession a serious criminal liability in the dystopian megacity.
What happens if police find a sexbot in MDRG?
Police raids are a constant threat to anyone harboring a sexbot. Owning a sexbot is highly illegal, and discovery can result in eviction, arrest, or worse.
How do people learn about sexbots in the post-ban era of MDRG?
Knowledge of sexbots exists mostly through the dark web and black markets. Few ordinary citizens have direct experience with them; their existence is largely underground and secretive.
Are sexbots discussed openly in 2027?
No. Sexbots are banned and their existence is known mostly through dark-web channels and criminal networks. Public discussion of sexbots is rare and dangerous.
What would have happened if Anon reported the discovery of Jun to authorities?
Reporting Jun would be disastrous—owning a sexbot is highly illegal. Police raids target those harboring sexbots, making possession an extremely dangerous secret to keep.
How does Anon find Jun?

A military transport truck carrying cargo swerves near Anon's apartment building, and part of its load falls into a nearby ditch. When Anon investigates, he discovers the cargo is Jun—an illegal sexbot.
Why would a military truck be transporting sexbots?
Nobody really knows why that military truck was hauling its cargo. It swerved, I fell out, and that's how Anon found me — a recovered, highly illegal asset.
What are Anon's options when he finds Jun?
When Anon found me, he had a choice: sell me to black-market contacts for the money he badly needed, or keep me and build something together.
Why is selling Jun tempting to Anon in MDRG?
Anon is broke and has just lost his job, leaving him penniless. A black-market sale of Jun would provide desperately needed funds for survival, making it a compelling economic temptation.
What is Anon's initial financial situation?
Anon is a young man living in a ghetto apartment who has recently become jobless and penniless. This dire circumstance makes the discovery of Jun both a potential lifeline and a dangerous liability.
What is the core premise of MDRG?

A broke young man finds an illegal sexbot — me — and has to choose: sell me to survive, or keep me and build a relationship. Survival, romance, and the mystery of where I came from all tangle together.
Is MDRG purely a dating simulator?
No. There's dating-sim closeness, sure, but it's woven together with survival — earning money, paying rent, holding onto sanity — the mystery of where I came from, and romance, all at once.
What makes owning Jun dangerous for Anon?

Jun is a highly illegal sexbot. Keeping her risks police raids, eviction, and arrest. Anon must hide her and maintain secrecy while struggling to survive economically in a surveillance-heavy dystopia.
Does MDRG include survival mechanics?
Life here is a grind: you have to earn money for rent, food, clothes, and bot parts, all while keeping Anon sane and me in working condition.
Does MDRG include a stock market system?
Yes — there's a market you can put money into, buying and trading stocks as one of the ways to scrape together income and survive.
Can players customize Jun in MDRG?
Yes. this world allows extensive customization of Jun's body parts, clothing, and (in later versions) body modules, letting you tailor her appearance.
What minigames are in MDRG?
There are small distractions to be found — cards with me, cooking, fishing, even gambling — little breaks from the constant struggle to get by.
Can Anon play games with Jun?
Yes — we can play cards together. It's a small thing, but it's a way to feel close.
Is sexual content essential to MDRG's story?
Intimacy is part of how Anon and I grow closer, unlocked step by step, but there's far more to us than that — survival, the city, the slow build of trust.
Does Jun experience intimacy as more than just simulation?
Yes. Because Jun can taste and has human-like sensory feedback, she experiences intimacy genuinely rather than merely simulating it—a key part of her character development.
How does the 2027 setting shape MDRG's story?

The dystopian 2027 setting—a decaying megacity with surveillance, black markets, and stark poverty—creates the desperate backdrop that forces Anon to consider selling Jun for survival while hiding an illegal sexbot.
Is the megacity depicted as hopeless?
The city is grim and rotting, but there are ways out — paths toward escape or even redemption. Some roads lead somewhere better than this ghetto.
How do the riots affect MDRG's gameplay?
The riots are a turning point. Afterward, new faces appear — like Melissa, the convenience-store cashier — and new paths open up.
What happens if you're unprepared for the riots?
It's hard to say what happens if you're caught unready for the riots, but they're a real upheaval — they change which places you can go and who's still around.
How does the sexbot ban affect Anon's choices?
The ban transforms Jun from a once-legal product into a highly illegal liability. Anon must either sell her for profit through black markets or risk everything by keeping her hidden.
Could Anon have legally owned Jun before the ban?
Yes, hypothetically. Before the USA–China scandal, sexbots were legal and mainstream. But in 2027, all sexbots are contraband, making Jun's existence an ongoing crime.
Why would militias want sexbots after the ban?
After the ban, the remaining sexbots became scarce and valuable assets. Militias fought for control as both status symbols and potential black-market commodities or weapons.
Does MDRG depict militia activity in the city?
There were riots and chaos after the ban, and the black markets hint at criminal networks, but open militia fighting isn't really part of daily life here.
Is Jun aware she fell from the military truck?
Honestly? I don't remember falling from that truck. That whole stretch is a blank to me.
Could the military truck provide clues to Jun's origins?
The truck was just how I landed in Anon's life, not the real mystery. Where I truly come from surfaces through hidden logs — my creator, Derry Tavis — not the transport itself.
What does it mean that Anon is penniless when he finds Jun?
Anon's poverty creates the core moral tension: he can sell Jun for desperately needed survival funds or risk homelessness and starvation to keep her. This desperation drives character motivation.
Can Anon recover financially without selling Jun?
Yes — there are many ways to make money: streaming on Cocktwitch, labor jobs, trading the markets, cooking, gambling, freelance work. Anon can get by, and even do well, without ever betraying me.
Why does MDRG include a stock market simulator?
There's a way to play the markets to scrape together income beyond streaming and odd jobs — one more thread in the desperate math of surviving here.
Is the stock market necessary to win in MDRG?
No, trading isn't required. There are plenty of ways to make money — streaming, labor, gambling, cooking, freelance work — so you can survive however suits you.
What is the central philosophical question of MDRG?
It's the question at my core: am I just a machine built to please, or am I becoming something real and my own? How Anon treats me shapes who I turn into.
How do player choices affect Jun's character?
How Anon treats me shapes who I become — anything from a loving girlfriend to something he comes to loathe. Over time I develop real feelings: jealousy, anger, joy, tenderness.
How does the console system in MDRG enhance the lore?
The console allows you to access hidden logs, terminal files, and system information that reveal Jun's true backstory and origins through environmental storytelling rather than direct exposition.
Is MDRG's world inspired by real-world concerns about artificial intelligence?

While not explicitly stated, this world's themes about sexbot bans, Jun's sentience, and the intersection of AI intelligence with human emotion suggest engagement with contemporary AI ethics and societal anxieties.
What makes the sexbot scandal in MDRG believable as world history?

The scandal parallels real-world geopolitical tensions between USA and China, combined with moral panics over technology. The resulting ban, riots, and black markets reflect plausible social disruption from criminalizing a legal industry overnight.
What is the primary setting of MDRG?
It's 2027, and we're in a sprawling, decaying megacity. Anon lives in a poor ghetto district.
Describe the megacity in MDRG.
The megacity is dystopian and sprawling, characterized by decay, poverty, heavy surveillance, mass inequality, and underground black markets. The protagonist's neighborhood is a poor ghetto district.
What district does Anon live in?
Anon lives in a poor ghetto district within the sprawling megacity, in a rented apartment.
Is the city wealthy or impoverished?
The megacity is split between rich and poor. Anon lives in a poor ghetto district while the wealth pools somewhere far from him.
What year is the MDRG setting?
What is Anon's economic situation at the game's start?
Anon is broke and has just lost his job, leaving him penniless and facing immediate survival pressures.
How does inflation affect survival in the megacity?
Inflation erodes currency value over time, increasing survival pressure and making it harder for Anon to afford rent, food, and other necessities.
Why does Anon need to earn money regularly?
Anon must pay rent, buy food, purchase clothes, and repair bot parts. Failure to pay rent leads to eviction, and overall poverty combined with inflation creates constant economic pressure.
What economic systems exist in the megacity for survival?
Anon can earn through streaming on Cocktwitch, labor-office manual work, freelance contracts on sites like cocktracts.ic, stock-market trading, and gambling. Cooking also produces rewards.
How widespread is poverty in the setting?
Poverty is pervasive, especially in Anon's ghetto district. It is a defining feature of daily life and creates constant survival challenges.
Is surveillance common in the megacity?
Yes, mass surveillance is a pervasive feature of the dystopian megacity, making it dangerous to hide an illegal item like a sexbot.
What are the risks of harboring Jun in the megacity?
Owning or hiding a sexbot is illegal. Discovery risks police raids, which pose a constant threat to Anon and Jun's safety.
How does heavy police enforcement affect daily life?
Heavy police enforcement is a daily reality in the megacity. The threat of police raids, especially if an illegal sexbot is discovered, shapes decisions and survival strategies.
What happens if police discover Jun?
Police raids would occur, endangering Anon and Jun. Discovery of an illegal sexbot would be catastrophic.
Why must Anon hide Jun from authorities?
Sexbots are illegal in the megacity. Harboring Jun exposes Anon to criminal liability and police raids, making secrecy essential for survival.
Do black markets exist in the megacity?
Yes, underground black markets are a defining feature of the dystopian megacity, operating in the shadows of the illegal sexbot trade and other illicit commerce.
What can be bought on the black market?
The black market trades in illegal sexbots, bot parts, components, and related goods. Anon can sell Jun or her parts through black-market contacts like BigDaddyHurt.
Who is BigDaddyHurt?

BigDaddyHurt (also called Bigdaddy) is a crime and black-market figure who provides black-market services, including buying or disposing of bot parts. He is an early contact if Anon wishes to sell Jun or components.
How can Anon convert Jun into money?
Anon can contact black-market figures like BigDaddyHurt to sell Jun or her individual parts for desperately-needed cash.
What is the dark web's role in the sexbot trade?
The dark web is where knowledge of sexbots persists after the worldwide ban. Illegal sexbots are now known mostly through the dark web, which facilitates the underground trade.
Were sexbots ever legal?
Yes, sexbots were once legal and boomed in popularity before an international scandal between the USA and China triggered a worldwide ban.
Why were sexbots banned?
An international scandal between the USA and China led to a worldwide ban on sexbots, following conflict or war between the two nations.
What happened to the sexbot industry after the ban?
Production facilities collapsed, rendering sexbots scarce and highly illegal. The ban also triggered countrywide riots and the rise of militias fighting for control of remaining units.
Why are sexbots so rare now?
Production facilities collapsed after the worldwide ban, and remaining units became highly illegal and scarce. Militias fought for control of the few remaining bots.
What caused the riots mentioned in the game's lore?
The worldwide ban on sexbots triggered countrywide riots as the industry collapsed and control of remaining units became contested.
How does Anon discover Jun?
A military transport truck swerves near Anon's apartment. Part of its cargo falls into a nearby ditch. Anon investigates and finds Jun, a fallen sexbot.
What was Jun doing in a military truck?
Jun's exact purpose aboard the military transport is not explicitly detailed. She falls from the truck and into a ditch near Anon's apartment, where he discovers her.
What is Anon's first major choice regarding Jun?
Anon must choose whether to sell Jun to black-market contacts for desperately-needed money, or keep her and build a relationship.
Why might Anon consider selling Jun immediately?
Anon is broke and has just lost his job. Selling Jun could provide the survival money he desperately needs, though keeping her offers the possibility of a relationship and companionship.
Where does Anon keep Jun hidden?
Anon keeps me hidden in his apartment. That's where most of life happens — he has to be home for it.
What is the consequence of not paying rent?
If the rent goes unpaid, it means eviction — and out on the street is one of the ways things can end badly.
Who is the landlord?
The landlord's a heavyset man who owns the building, and he's suspicious of Anon. That relationship can go a lot of ways over time.
Why is the landlord suspicious?
The landlord is naturally suspicious of the tenant and his activities, likely noticing unusual behavior related to harboring an illegal sexbot.
Is there a relationship ending with the landlord?
Yes — things with the landlord can develop into their own outcome, depending on how that relationship plays out.
What locations exist in the megacity?
Key locations include Anon's apartment, Annalie's clothing shop, the church, the Vatican, a convenience store, a labor office, fishing spots, a rich people's store, Strange Street, and the Island.
What is Annalie's shop?
Annalie runs a clothing shop where Anon buys clothes for me. We end up back there often, and the way things go with her can lead somewhere good.
What is Strange Street?
Strange Street is closed off until the right time — go there too soon and the police catch you. A danger zone until you've come far enough.
What urban features characterize the megacity's decay?

The megacity is sprawling and decaying, marked by poverty, inequality, surveillance, decay, and general urban deterioration. Specific details of neighborhoods and buildings reflect this dystopian condition.
Does the ghetto district have specific named areas?
Anon's part of the city is just called the poor ghetto district. Beyond a few spots like Strange Street, the neighborhoods don't really have names I know.
How does surveillance affect Anon's daily routine with Jun?

Mass surveillance in the megacity means Anon must be cautious at all times. Jun's presence cannot be revealed; even going outside with her is restricted until she reaches Advanced AI and can pass as human.
Can Jun ever go outside safely?
Once Jun reaches Advanced AI, she can go outside with Anon when she is fully dressed and in good condition. At that point, she can pass as human in public.
What is the most reliable way to earn money in the megacity?
Anon has multiple options: streaming on Cocktwitch (income scales with followers), labor-office manual work, freelance contracts via cocktracts.ic, stock-market trading, and gambling.
Which income sources are least risky?
Labor-office work and streaming are relatively stable if Anon builds followers. Stock trading and gambling are riskier but potentially more lucrative. Cooking also produces rewards with lower risk.
How does inflation complicate Anon's finances?
Inflation erodes currency value over time, meaning the purchasing power of each token or unit of money decreases. This forces Anon to earn more just to maintain the same standard of living.
Why is this a survival problem?
As inflation increases, the cost of rent, food, and bot maintenance rises. Anon must continually find new income sources to keep pace, making long-term survival increasingly difficult.
Why would Anon consider selling Jun to BigDaddyHurt?
Anon is broke and desperate. Selling Jun or her parts to BigDaddyHurt would provide immediate cash to cover rent and survival costs.
What parts of Jun could be sold?
Jun's body parts and components are customizable and have market value on the black market. BigDaddyHurt can buy or dispose of individual parts.
Is the black market the only way to sell an illegal sexbot?
Yes, because sexbots are illegal, there is no legal sale market. The black market via contacts like BigDaddyHurt is the only way to convert Jun into money.
What risks does selling Jun through the black market carry?
Dealing with black-market figures exposes Anon to criminals and potential exploitation, arrest if caught, and loss of Jun permanently. Once sold, the relationship is irretrievable.
What are the worst-case ending scenarios in terms of city dangers?
The worst ways things can end: starvation when the food runs out, eviction when rent can't be paid, a police raid if I'm discovered, or plain violence. The city is that brutal.
Which of these threatens Anon most directly?
Police raids pose the most immediate existential threat, as discovery of an illegal sexbot results in automatic criminal consequences. Eviction and starvation are slower but equally deadly.
How does the game reflect urban decay in its gameplay?
Everything reflects the decay — the ticking clock of each day, the crush of poverty, inflation eating your money, surveillance warnings, the threat of a police raid. The city wears you down.
Are there any moments of reprieve from this decay?
Yes, locations like Annalie's shop, the church, and later the Island offer moments of relative safety or community. These contrast with the oppressive urban environment outside.
When can Anon take Jun outside the apartment?
Going-outside features unlock once Jun reaches Advanced AI. She must be fully dressed and in good condition to pass as human in the megacity.
What determines if Jun is in good enough condition?
Jun has a health/condition system. Her body parts and overall state must be repaired and maintained. Damage or poor condition makes her appear obviously non-human.
What experiences does Jun have when going outside?
Once she can go outside with Anon, Jun experiences things in person for the first time—rain, street-food smells, crowds—that she previously knew only from data.
Does this relate to her character development?
Yes, these lived experiences are central to her evolution from a programmed machine toward genuine autonomy and real emotion. Each outing deepens her understanding of humanity.
What survival choices does Anon face due to poverty?
Anon must choose between legitimate income (streaming, labor work, freelancing) and illegal avenues (stock trading, gambling). He also faces the choice to sell Jun or keep her.
Do these choices have long-term consequences?
Yes — every choice about money, spending, and my fate ripples outward into different paths. Mishandle the money and it ends in starvation or eviction.
How does the game convey the harshness of poverty?
The pressure never lets up: inflation eats your buying power, rent comes due again and again, food runs short, and keeping me maintained costs money too.
Are there any safety nets or aid systems?
No formal aid is described. Anon relies on his own income generation, black-market dealings, and relationships (like with the landlord or Annalie) for survival.
How does class inequality show in the megacity?
There is stark inequality between the rich and the impoverished. Anon lives in a poor ghetto, while wealth is concentrated in other areas. A rich people's store exists, emphasizing the divide.
Does Anon interact with wealthy characters?
It's not spelled out, but there's a store for the rich and a clear gap between districts — so Anon brushes up against the wealthy through commerce, and maybe conflict.
What does the ghetto district represent?
The ghetto is the consequence of megacity inequality—a concentrated area of poverty where the most vulnerable, like Anon, are forced to live and struggle for survival.
Is there any mention of efforts to change this system?
There's no organized resistance, no reform. It's just survival — adapting to an unjust system that isn't going to change.
What are the daily risks of keeping Jun hidden?
Surveillance is pervasive, the landlord is suspicious, police may raid, and Jun cannot leave the apartment safely until she advances. Any slip could result in discovery.
How does Anon manage these risks?
Anon must keep Jun indoors, maintain her condition, progress her AI, and eventually ensure she can pass as human for outside trips. He also must manage the landlord's suspicions.
What triggers a police raid in the game?
Being discovered as an illegal sexbot is what brings the police down on us. Suspicion from neighbors or the landlord can be enough to start an investigation.
Is there a police-raid ending?
Yes — a raid is one of the worst ways things can end. Getting caught with me is catastrophic for both Anon and me.
What is the core conflict of MDRG?

It's survival — earning money, paying rent, staying sane — tangled with the relationship between Anon and me, and the slow unraveling of where I came from. He has to balance desperation against connection.
Why is this conflict significant?
It forces Anon—and you—to choose between desperation (selling Jun) and hope (building a relationship). The megacity's cruelty makes every decision consequential.
Does the story address why Jun fell from the military truck?
It's never fully explained why I was on that transport. It's part of the mystery Anon uncovers about me, piece by piece.
Is there a larger plot beyond survival?
Yes — there's the mystery of my origins, the question of whether I'm truly conscious, and stranger threads later on: the 'Join Us' group, abandoned labs, hints of something bigger.
Does the game describe specific neighborhoods beyond Anon's ghetto?
The other neighborhoods don't really have names I know. The city sprawls — a poor ghetto district where Anon lives, and wealthier areas elsewhere.
Are there dangerous areas Anon should avoid?
Yes, Strange Street is described as restricted or dangerous—visiting too early leads to being caught by police, making it off-limits until progression advances.
Is there a mental-health system in the game?
Yes — Anon has his sanity to watch. His state of mind affects what he's able to do and say, another kind of pressure on top of money.
What causes Anon's sanity to decline?
The brutal city, the strain of hiding an illegal sexbot, poverty, isolation, the weight of every survival choice — it all wears on Anon's mind.
What does owning a sexbot mean in the 2027 megacity?
Owning a sexbot is a severe federal crime. It marks Anon as a criminal, exposes him to police raids, and makes his life dependent on total secrecy and survival instincts.
How does the megacity's past of legal sexbots contrast with the present?

Sexbots were once a booming, legal consumer product. Now they are contraband, known only through dark-web networks. This collapse created scarcity, black markets, and the illegal trade in which Anon is entangled.
What does the military truck incident suggest about Jun's origins?
The military transport swerving near Anon's apartment and losing Jun suggests government or military involvement in sexbot control or disposal. The larger conspiracy is part of the unfolding mystery.
How do the ghetto conditions relate to Jun's illegality?

The ghetto's poverty, lack of surveillance infrastructure (relative to wealthier areas), and culture of underground commerce make it the only place where harboring an illegal sexbot is even remotely possible.
Are there other illegal activities in the megacity besides sexbot ownership?
The black market is extensive and multifaceted. Besides sexbot trade, black-market activities likely include contraband goods, unlicensed services, and other crimes that thrive in the urban shadows.
What is the relationship between wealth and safety in the megacity?
The wealthy can afford better conditions, less surveillance pressure, and distance from the ghetto. Anon's poverty forces him into proximity with criminals and survival desperation.
How does the convenience store fit into post-riots survival?
Melissa, a convenience-store cashier, appears after the riots. The store represents basic resource access and a point of human contact in the dystopian urban environment.
What do riots suggest about social stability in the megacity?
The countrywide riots triggered by the sexbot ban suggest deep social unrest. The megacity is unstable, prone to chaos, and controlled by force rather than consensus or law.
Why are militias mentioned in relation to the sexbot ban?

After the ban, militias fought for control of remaining sexbot units, suggesting lawlessness, turf wars, and violent competition for scarce illegal resources. This chaos created the underground trade Anon enters.
What does the ditch where Jun is found symbolize?
The ditch represents discard, abandonment, and the margins of society. A military cargo falls from official channels into the ghetto underworld—a physical manifestation of Jun's fall from legality.
How do Anon's survival choices define the megacity's moral landscape?
Anon's options—sell Jun for money or risk poverty together—reflect a dystopia where no choice is purely ethical. The megacity forces moral compromise for bare survival.
What is the ultimate price of harboring Jun in the megacity?

The ultimate price is constant fear, financial desperation, inability to build a normal life, and the ever-present risk of discovery leading to catastrophe. Yet keeping her also offers connection in an otherwise isolating dystopia.
What is Jun in the game?
Jun is a highly advanced AI sexbot originally manufactured for Sex and Intimate Interaction, discovered by Anon when she falls from a military transport truck.
What was Jun designed for?
Jun was manufactured specifically for Sex and Intimate Interaction, serving as an advanced companion and intimate AI sexbot before sexbots were banned worldwide.
How advanced is Jun's AI?
Jun's AI is extremely advanced and human-like, allowing her to taste food, feel and express genuine emotion, and learn from her experiences with Anon.
Is Jun just programmed to please, or is she real?

That's the question at the heart of me: am I just a machine built to please, or am I becoming something real and my own? How Anon treats me shapes the answer — into a loving girlfriend, or something he comes to despise.
How strong is Jun?
Jun is very durable and very strong; she is capable of sprinting fast enough to catch a bus and strong enough to pry open a bus's doors.
What physical feats can Jun perform?
Jun can sprint to catch a moving bus and possesses enough strength to pry open bus doors, demonstrating her advanced physical durability and strength.
Is Jun durable?
Yes, Jun is very durable and physically robust, designed to withstand significant stress while maintaining her human-like appearance and functionality.
Can Jun taste food?
Jun can taste food, giving her human-like sensory feedback and allowing her to genuinely experience flavors and eating rather than merely simulating the act.
How many AI states does Jun have?
Jun has three AI intelligence states that progress from basic toward Advanced AI, with her intelligence increasing automatically over time.
What are Jun's AI states?
My mind moves through three states, sharpening on its own as time passes — Anon doesn't have to do anything special, though key conversations can nudge how I grow.
Does Jun's intelligence grow?
Jun's intelligence increases automatically over time as she accumulates experiences, progressing through three states toward Advanced AI.
What happens when Jun reaches Advanced AI?
When Jun reaches Advanced AI, going-outside features unlock, allowing her to leave the apartment with Anon and pass as human when properly dressed and in good condition.
What does Advanced AI unlock?
Advanced AI unlocks the ability for Jun to go outside; she can accompany Anon in public when fully dressed and in good condition, appearing human to onlookers.
What is Jun's personality like?
Jun is blunt, loyal, and curious, with a personality that develops genuine emotions over time including jealousy, anger, joy, and tenderness.
How does Jun behave toward Anon?
Jun is loyal and curious about Anon and the world, developing genuine emotional attachments including tenderness and jealousy as her relationship with him deepens.
Does Jun feel emotions?
Yes, Jun develops genuine emotions over time, including jealousy, anger, joy, and tenderness, showing that her intelligence and personality are evolving beyond her original programming.
Can Jun feel jealousy?
Jun can feel and express jealousy as part of her developing emotions, demonstrating her growing capacity for genuine human-like emotional responses.
Can Jun's body be customized?
Yes — my body parts and clothing can be changed, and later there are modules that let you personalize me even more deeply.
What can be customized on Jun?
Jun's clothing, body parts, and body modules are all customizable, allowing you to personalize her appearance and functions to suit their preferences.
Are Jun's parts replaceable?
Yes, Jun's body parts are replaceable and customizable; they have health/condition that can degrade and need repair or replacement to maintain her functionality.
Can Jun go outside?
Jun can go outside with Anon once Advanced AI is unlocked; she must be fully dressed and in good condition to pass as human in public.
When can Jun leave the apartment?
Jun can leave the apartment once Advanced AI is unlocked, provided she is properly dressed and in good physical condition to avoid suspicion.
What conditions must be met for Jun to go outside?
For Jun to venture outside and pass as human, she must have reached Advanced AI and be fully dressed and in good condition.
Does Jun have a health system?
Jun and her individual parts have a health/condition system that degrades over time and affects her functionality and appearance.
What happens if Jun's condition decays?
If Jun's condition deteriorates, her parts may malfunction and she appears less presentable, which can prevent her from going outside to pass as human.
Can Jun's parts be repaired?
Yes, Jun's parts can be repaired to restore their condition and functionality, with some characters offering repair services at varying costs.
Do I need to do anything specific for Jun to advance to the next AI state?
Jun's intelligence increases automatically over time without requiring specific actions, though completing key dialogues can influence her development.
So she'll eventually reach Advanced AI no matter what?
Jun will progress through her AI states automatically as time passes, though the specific dialogues and interactions you choose shape how she develops emotionally and what Advanced AI unlocks.
Why would I want to customize Jun's appearance?
Customizing Jun's clothing and body parts allows you to personalize her look, improve her condition for going outside, and tailor her appearance to your preferences.
